semantics.mechanism: After a compression regime (ATR below its mean), a range-expansion bar (>k*ATR) signals a volatility breakout; trade its direction. NOTE: S4 was found NEGATIVE — expansion direction is near-random without a trend filter (the fix is S23).
semantics.signal_reason: Prior compression for `min_compress` bars; an expansion bar range>k*ATR; direction = the expansion bar colour; enter next open.

entry.description: A range-expansion bar (>1.5*ATR) after >=1 of the prior 2 bars were compressed; direction = the expansion bar's own colour.

exit.description: 1.5*ATR-at-entry trailing stop (frozen engine's own exit=trailing convention); no fixed price target.

stop.description: 2 ticks past the expansion bar's own extreme.

risk_model.stop_floor: executable risk = max(2*spread_ticks*tick, 5*tick, 0.10*ATR) = max(0.20, 0.50, 0.10*ATR) price units (v2, pre-registered)
risk_model.costs: (spread 1 + slippage 1) ticks/side * 0.1 = 0.10/side; 0.20 round-trip charged in R

position_sizing.stop_floor: executable risk = max(2*spread_ticks*tick, 5*tick, 0.10*ATR) = max(0.20, 0.50, 0.10*ATR) price units (v2, pre-registered)
